_README: ZEROX FOMO receiving wallets, shown by the Paybox button on enter.html via GET /api/paybox/wallets. These are PUBLIC receiving addresses, not secrets — they are meant to be displayed. They live here rather than in HTML so rotating one is a config change and not a redeploy, and so a single wrong character is caught in review rather than shipped in a page. Read fresh on every request: edit this file and the change is live immediately.
_WARNING: Verify any change against the wallet itself before committing. A wrong address here sends funds to nobody and there is no undo.
